scope: Segment DL7 TLV download-data container ('^' + 3-digit Segment Length + <tag><len><data> Download Data per Appendix W), using Segment-Length-based framing rather than the DL1-DL6 Data-Type/End-of-Data marker pattern
extractionEvidence: regression-artifact-validator/specifications/ATL105/docs/specs/extracted_text.txt lines 17587-17634 (Section 12.48), 35814-35830 (Appendix W Download Data Layout), 21313-21345 and 25160-25166 (Section 13.2 Elements 84 and 232), 20052-20083 (Element 24)

rules.title: Segment DL7 is identified by the special character '^' (Data Type Indicator, Element 24) but, UNLIKE Segments DL1-DL6, does NOT use an End-of-Data Indicator; instead it uses a Segment Length Indicator (Element 84) to frame the segment, matching the pattern used by numbered segments (100-157) rather than the DL1-DL6 marker convention
rules.note: A genuinely distinctive hybrid: DL7/DL8 combine the DL-family's Data Type Indicator with the numbered-segment family's Segment Length Indicator, and drop the End-of-Data Indicator entirely.

rules.title: Segment Length Indicator (Element 84) for Segment DL7 is EXCLUSIVE of the Data Type Indicator's length — a distinct counting convention from most numbered segments, which INCLUDE the Segment Type's length in their Segment Length
rules.note: Whether the value includes the three Segment Length digits themselves, and why the Source is 'Device' on a host download, are open (SEGDL7-SME-005).

rules.title: Download Data (Element 232, max 100 characters) is required, in <tag><len><data> format, with detailed layout defined in Appendix W (Download Data Layout)
rules.note: Appendix W scope is resolved for this training pass; the independent table checks and unresolved an1 attribute conflict are documented in the Appendix W training module. Outer DL7 message and segment framing remain separate.

rules.title: Each Download Data entry is Table ID (n3) + Table Length (n3) + Table Data; Appendix W defines Table ID 001 Site Language (Table Length 003, ISO 639-2 language code of the terminal) and Table ID 002 Postal Code (Table Length 013, international postal code of the transmitting device)
rules.note: Appendix W lists the Table Data attribute as 'an1' for both tables, which contradicts Table Lengths 003 and 013 (SEGDL7-SME-003).

rules.title: Download Data (Element 232) is alphanumeric, variable length up to 100 bytes, and holds 'all or some of the Download Data'
rules.note: 'All or some' implies Download Data may span more than one DL7; whether and how is open (SEGDL7-SME-004).

rules.title: The DL7 Segment Length (Element 84) is three digits — DL7 is not one of the seven segments allowed a four-digit Segment Length — and must equal the length of the segment content after the Data Type Indicator
